findings.detail: All 44 required faults run against isolated proving stores and worker subprocesses under JARVIS_R12_TEMP; live daemon/db/vault/protected main and owner projects are never touched. Live guards record protected_state_unchanged=True within the recorded windows.
findings.title: Fault campaign is staged over isolated copies

findings.detail: The final adoption rungs simulate live-like operation over isolated copies because the live deployment is protected. No live deployment changes were made; the proving window is readiness-verified, not started.
findings.title: BOUNDED_LIVE and FULL_DIGITAL_WORK_OPERATION are staged simulations

findings.detail: V7 was snapshotted from protected main tag v8-pre-promotion-93a3ddc with git archive into JARVIS_R12_TEMP; the protected main tree was never mutated and the recoverable release was never overwritten.
findings.title: FROZEN V7 comparison uses a read-only git archive snapshot

findings.detail: R12-G01..G05 evidence is complete; R12-G06 records audit package readiness with independent_audit_status=PENDING and verdict NOT_TESTED. A fresh independent verifier must reproduce the package and return exactly one of SERVES_ORIGINAL_PURPOSE / SERVES_PURPOSE_WITH_EXTERNAL_BLOCKERS / DOES_NOT_YET_SERVE_PURPOSE.
findings.title: Builder status and final verdict remain NOT_TESTED until fresh independent audit

findings.detail: R12_PROGRESS_*.json are incremental working artifacts; evidence_bytes() and the manifest exclude them so the closed package matches the on-disk payload byte-for-byte.
findings.title: Progress checkpoints excluded from closure evidence

findings.detail: R6 files and records were not touched; PROGRAM_STATE.md records OWNER_REDIRECT_R6_DEFERRED and R12 confinement keeps R6 trees outside the allowed write prefixes.
findings.title: R6 remains owner-redirect and never reopened

findings.detail: The live-guard comparison bracketing the full repository suite observed the protected process command set change from 4 to 2 (unrelated live supervisor processes stopping); r12_attributable_mutation was False and protected files, main, tasks, and vault were unchanged. A quiet-window before/after/compare after all R12 work recorded protected_state_unchanged=True; the full-window captures are preserved as R12_LIVE_GUARD_FULLWINDOW_*.
findings.title: External supervisor process churn during the full-suite window

findings.detail: The final auditor found R12_RELEASE_FREEZE.json recorded source tree ffe65cd9... while the final source recomputed to ebf90e2e... because fault_campaign/worker_sim.py was edited after the freeze was generated, and the freeze was never refreshed. The freeze also included __pycache__ bytecode in the source tree hash. release_freeze.py now (a) clears its proving workspace before seeding so a fresh run always succeeds, (b) excludes __pycache__ and .pyc files from the source tree manifest, and (c) was re-run on the exact final source; proving_window.py now derives its release fingerprint from the freeze's source tree hash. The regenerated freeze binds source tree ef426a85... (222 files, no bytecode) at head c76d92d, and the closure was regenerated.
findings.title: Release freeze and proving readiness did not bind the exact final source

findings.detail: The source tree manifest now excludes __pycache__ directories and .pyc files so the freeze binds source truth, not build artifacts.
findings.title: Freeze source tree hash excluded bytecode
